1.title: Federal Judge Orders Bureau of Prisons to Restore Union Protections
1.summary: In his ruling, Judge Vernon D. Oliver cited public statements from the bureau’s director that hurt the agency’s case in court.

2.title: Trump Plays Defense in Midterm Tour Across Republican Strongholds
2.summary: Some deep-red areas are in need of a jolt.

3.title: States That Ban Abortion Challenge Shield Laws for Providers Who Mail Pills
3.summary: The lawsuit filed by Louisiana, Alabama and Arkansas to the Supreme Court escalates the battle between states that outlaw abortion and those that support nationwide access by mail.

4.title: Trekkers helicoptered off mountains as more deadly landslides hit Nepal
4.summary: A month after mass catastrophic flooding, around 30 people have died in landslides and heavy rain.

5.title: What we know about stabbing on Flydubai flight to Israel
5.summary: A pilot has been arrested and is being questioned after another pilot was stabbed, officials say.

6.title: UK Believes Iran Played a Part in RAF Fairford Air Base Incident, Burnham Says
6.summary: The British prime minister, Andy Burnham, said there were “strong indications” Iran played a part in the events at R.A.F. Fairford on Sunday, without providing details why.
